groundFloor.name: Daily Paper
groundFloor.note: Dated 2024-11-29: black fascia with white DAILY PAPER lettering, glazed double door between lattice-grilled windows. On 2023-01-12 the same front read BOUWBAK.NL; modelled as of 2024. BAG has no ground unit for no. 133.

rhythm.bays: 3 identical bays, balconies on the middle bay of storeys 1-2 (the right bay of storey 2 has a flower box)
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: shop glass + door | 1-3: 3 | roof: 1 tall brick-framed dormer with a French window
rhythm.roofline: white cornice band, top at strip row 272 (14.0 m above the strip ground; 3DBAG eaves 17.0 m is the dormer top), red-tile roof face to row 178 (16.4 m), one brick-framed dormer standing on the cornice over the middle bay, pediment base row 155, apex row 115
schemaLimits: the dormer is a brick tower over bay 1 with a flat cap (tower, rise 0.92): the pointed stone pediment (rows 155-115) is not modelled; a pyramid cap leaves no room for the window under the 3DBAG height gate
flower boxes on the storey-3 sills are not modelled

notes: 2024-11-29 capture; 2023-01-12 ground floor of 133 read BOUWBAK.NL.

measuredEaves.evidence: top of the white cornice band under the red-tile roof (row 272, 14.0 m); the tile roof face meets the roof top at row 178 (16.4 m) beside the dormer (zoom 164549 roofline, x 230-474, rows 90-320); 3DBAG eaves 17.0 m reads the dormer top
